canon: Hija adoptiva de un artesano Serhu, huye sola tras su muerte; cazadora, lleva un cuchillo corto y un odre. Orca de las Llanuras (fichas/raza/orcos-llanuras.json, hembra).
propuestas: sin banner propio a propósito: sigue el diseño de hembra orca de las Llanuras (usuaria, 2026-11-09; fichas/raza/orcos-llanuras.json y su banner de hembra), sin hachas: huye con un cuchillo corto y un odre

capas.notas: IMG-54, plantilla por capas (scripts/capas.py): forma sin color en los campos de lápiz; color, paleta y luz solo en el paso a foto. Truco de la usuaria en dos pasos: P1 sin palabras femeninas (sale fuerte), edición que nombra solo el cambio; «young woman's face, smooth skin» le quita lo orco. «Orc» trae el orco de videojuego; la analogía del jabalí curva los colmillos.
capas.sujeto: A tusked warrior of a steppe people standing alone at the mouth of a rocky hollow, seen from the knees up three-quarters from the front, the figure filling the left half of the image from the bottom edge to the top.
capas.tamano: The body is big, broad and powerful, built for long runs: heavy shoulders, thick strong arms and thighs, and long ropy muscles, all muscle and no fat.
capas.forma: The face is broad and fierce, with a heavy brow, a jutting lower jaw, small ears close to the head and wide-set eyes; two broad, long tusks rise straight up from the lower jaw past the upper lip. The skin is thick, dry and weathered like old leather, with a few raised lines of old scar tissue across the shoulders. Long hair is pulled back in thick braids threaded with small bone beads.
capas.viste: Worn, dusty travelling clothes: a sleeveless leather jerkin stitched with cord, a kilt of leather strips, a short ragged feather cloak on the shoulders, rawhide strips bound around the wrists, a short knife in a sheath at the hip and a leather waterskin slung across the back.
capas.pose: The figure looks back over one shoulder with a wary, alert expression, one hand resting on the knife.
capas.edicion: make this warrior a woman: give her a woman's chest under the leather tunic and remove any beard or moustache; her face, tusks, ears, braid, muscles and clothes stay as they are.
capas.entorno: Behind her, on the right, the rock walls of the hollow with cave mouths, and beyond them a wide plain under a hazy sky.
capas.color: Her skin is warm clay-beige, sand-coloured where the light touches it and deeper brown in the shade, mottled and weathered; the scars are paler; her eyes are amber; the tusks are off-white like old ivory. Her hair is black streaked with dark red. The jerkin and kilt are dark brown leather, the feathers dark ash-grey. The rocks are red and the plain beyond is red with straw-yellow grass.
capas.paleta: clay beige, leather brown and rust red
capas.luz: Clear warm daylight from high on the right.
